name: Lester Auto Detail

title: Tulsa's detail shop
on Route 66.
hero.sub: Full details, paint correction, headlight restoration and classic car care — right on historic Route 66 in midtown Tulsa.

servicesIntro: From a quick same-day refresh to bringing back a classic's paint, every job starts with a walk-around so you know exactly what you're getting.

services.name: Express Detail
services.desc: Hand wash, wheels, glass and a quick interior refresh. The easy way to stay ahead of Oklahoma dust and pollen.

services.name: Full Vehicle Detail
services.desc: Inside and out, top to bottom: carpets and seats extracted, plastics and leather cleaned, paint washed, decontaminated and protected.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.desc: Machine polishing to remove swirls, haze and light scratches, so the paint reflects like glass again.

services.name: Headlight Restoration
services.desc: Cloudy, yellowed lenses sanded, polished and sealed. Better looks and better light on the road at night.

services.name: Classic Car Detailing
services.desc: Single-stage paint, chrome and vintage interiors need a gentler hand and the right products. Show-ready, without the risk.

title: Old paint
deserves patience.
feature.text: Older single-stage and lacquer finishes behave differently from modern clear coat. We test first, go slow, and use the least aggressive step that gets the result — so the shine comes back and the paint stays.
